title: PostgreSQL
subtitle: A transactional relational database with replication and point-in-time recovery.

tiles.label: ACID transactions
tiles.says: PostgreSQL commits transactions atomically and durably.
tiles.detail: Correctness under concurrency protects money, inventory and customer records.

tiles.label: MVCC
tiles.says: MVCC lets readers and writers work without blocking.
tiles.detail: Snapshots keep reads consistent while vacuum reclaims old row versions.

tiles.label: Planner & indexes
tiles.says: The planner picks plans using statistics and indexes.
tiles.detail: B-tree, GIN and partial indexes turn slow scans into fast lookups; EXPLAIN shows why.

tiles.label: WAL
tiles.says: Every change is written to the WAL first.
tiles.detail: Sequential logging gives crash safety and feeds replication and recovery.

tiles.label: Streaming replica
tiles.detail: Hot standbys serve reads and can be promoted on failure.

tiles.label: Connection pooling
tiles.says: Poolers multiplex clients onto few server connections.
tiles.detail: PgBouncer cuts per-connection memory and protects the server from spikes.

tiles.label: Base backups
tiles.says: Base backups capture a consistent full copy.
tiles.detail: Scheduled backups to object storage keep restore points off the database host.

tiles.label: WAL archive
tiles.detail: Replaying logs to a timestamp recovers from human error.

tiles.label: Restore drills
tiles.detail: Tested recovery proves the backup works and makes recovery time predictable.

declarations: Write the log first, then the data.
Pool connections; do not multiply them.
Restore regularly to prove it works.
